title: Concept: Resolution override declared as a bare wildcard
description: package.json declares a `resolutions` entry of `*`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `resolutions` entry of `*`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `resolutions` entry of `*`.
